crossRefs.note: “He who is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and bathe himself in water; and he shall…
It shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all…

translations.web: He who lies down in the house shall wash his clothes; and he who eats in the house shall wash his clothes.
translations.bsb: And anyone who sleeps in the house or eats in it must wash his clothes.
translations.kjv: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
translations.asv: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
